_comment: Slice 433 item 6 (review pass 3). Each clip has its own recording, store-dino-<device label>-video-<clip>.mp4, made by .maestro/dino/store-shot-ios-video-<clip>.yaml, which starts on the held page: the unrecorded store-shot-ios-videoprep-<clip>.yaml did all navigation (dialogs, loading, waits) first. So the only thing before the clip is the recorder's own start-up, one constant (leadIn, seconds) for every clip, and a clip is that lead-in trimmed off plus its planned length (seconds). store-media.mjs and ios-sim-store-shots.sh both fail a recording shorter than leadIn + seconds. Tune leadIn once on a contact sheet of a real recording (npx hyperframes snapshot) in the device stage. Clips 1a and 1b are two 3 s clips (no shot over about 4 s: the note). Keep "leadIn" on one line of its own: the shell script reads it with sed.
